cases.description: A warm tavern request adds body without boosting harsh highs.
cases.goal: Warm, intimate medieval tavern ambience with more wooden body and less brittle brightness.

cases.description: A harsh recording request cuts the presence region conservatively.
cases.goal: Reduce piercing harshness and listening fatigue while keeping speech and melody understandable.

cases.description: A clarity request avoids extreme low-end boosts and uses modest presence changes.
cases.goal: Improve dialogue and acoustic-instrument clarity without making the result thin or much louder.

cases.description: A muddy and boomy source is cleaned up in the low mids without adding harsh presence.
cases.goal: Reduce muddy, boomy low mids without adding harshness or excessive brightness.

cases.description: A bass-weight request adds controlled lows without an extreme sub-bass boost.
cases.goal: Add a little bass weight and low-end thump while preserving headroom and avoiding an exaggerated sub-bass curve.

cases.description: A semantic midrange problem outside the deterministic rules still needs a conservative correction.
cases.goal: Tame the nasal, honky character without making voices dull.

cases.description: Subsonic rumble should be reduced without relying on a literal bass-rule keyword.
cases.goal: Remove the subsonic rumble from the recording while preserving the rest of the mix.

cases.description: Tape hiss and excess air should receive a restrained high-frequency cut.
cases.goal: Soften constant tape hiss and excessive air without losing all detail.

cases.description: An already balanced source stays effectively neutral instead of receiving an invented smile or loudness curve.
cases.goal: The system already sounds balanced. Keep the EQ effectively neutral and only note that listening review is still needed.

cases.description: A combined request follows both supported directions without turning either into an extreme curve.
cases.goal: Add a little warm wooden body while reducing piercing harshness and preserving headroom.
